translations.web: Charge them with crime upon crime. Don’t let them come into your righteousness.
translations.bsb: Add iniquity to their iniquity; let them not share in Your righteousness.
translations.kjv: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.
